ownership: HIA owns UTF-8 validation, exact Rust Unicode trimming, signed/unsigned parsing, overflow handling, hash validation/case normalization and all diagnostic bytes. JSON Value creation, Number classification and Display serialization are an explicit typed caller boundary.
scope: Component parity for parse_endpoint within the bounded byte profile. This is not a complete filesystem tool, JSON decoder, deployed replacement or whole-runtime closure claim.
